description: The crypto news cycle, clustered: groups the last N hours (1–72, default 24) of coverage from the three.ws aggregator into distinct narratives, each with a title, a plain-language summary, a bullish/bearish/neutral stance, the tickers involved, a coverage count, and links to every real article behind it. The response names the clustering engine honestly — "llm" (semantic grouping via the platform model chain, with hallucinated citations dropped) or "heuristic" (keyword+ticker Jaccard clustering) — plus an overall market mood and the most-covered tickers for the window. Ideal first call for "what happened in crypto today". For raw headlines use crypto_news; for history use crypto_news_archive. Free — no payment or API key required.
name: crypto_news_digest
title: Crypto news digest (clustered)
